acceptedScope: v1, SDK, and v2 historical preservation, unified v3 current-source succession, landed Git identity, and source-only authority boundaries
findings: The unified v3 lineage preserves the v1 closure, SDK successor, and v2 successor as immutable historical evidence while making one current-source successor authoritative.

The frozen subject binds the original landed commit and tree, requires current HEAD ancestry, covers every SDK and v2 gate input as a regular non-symlink file, and does not expand source-only authority.
